name: Roasted Cauliflower Grain Bowl
ingredients: ½ cup cooked bulgur or quinoa
1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp turmeric
Dressing: ¼ cup plain unsweetened soy yogurt, juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove (grated), salt, parsley
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the cauliflower and chickpeas with the oil, cumin, turmeric and salt.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Divide the grain and spinach between two bowls.
Top with the roasted mixture and drizzle with the dressing.
note: A nut-free, tahini-free bowl; the soy yogurt-lemon dressing gives the creamy tang.
